title: Senior PM - Communications
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Hey, I'm Liam, Group PM for Communications at Jane. I'm a New Zealander who's called Vancouver home for over 8 years, and outside of work you'll find me doing all the classic Pacific Northwest things: 50+ ski days a year, with the rest filled by hiking, biking and beaches (a sign of my Kiwi roots). I've spent most of my career building communications products in healthcare, and the rest in marketing automation. I came to Jane for the chance to shape the future of Jane and healthcare communication, and nine months in, both the opportunity and my excitement have only grown.

This role exists because our ambitions for Communications are growing. Much of a clinic's patient communication still happens outside of Jane, and it's one of the biggest demands on their time. You'll focus on net new areas, like additional channels, that bring more of that communication into Jane, and on where AI can help clinics stay on top of it. Alongside both, you'll contribute to some of our existing domains, like our Notifications Centre.

Our group is full of zero-to-one builders who are helping to shape the future of Jane and of healthcare, and you'll play a key role in that. You'll own a problem space end-to-end and take new products from idea to launch, but you won't be doing it alone - we've built a culture of collaboration where everyone, engineers included, helps shape the outcomes we focus on and the work that gets us there. If that sounds like your cup of tea, and you like to work hard, be kind, and have fun while you're at it, you'll be in great company - and I'd love to meet you.

What Impact We’re Looking for You to Make

  • Own a problem space within Communication from discovery and customer research through to shipping and GTM commercialization. You'll bring clarity to new, ambiguous areas and use good judgement to make decisions, knowing when there's enough information to move forward and when it's worth digging deeper.

  • Collaborate closely with partners beyond the PM, designer and engineer trio, including support, product marketing and communications design. At Jane, these partners play a core role in shaping our product, so you'll bring them in early and work with them throughout.

  • Work in the details, side by side with your engineers and designer, because this isn't a strategy-only role. Much of our work is zero to one, so you'll get tactical: refining edge cases, working through trade-offs, testing early prototypes and iterating until the solution is right.

  • Shape how we leverage AI in Communications in support of our group's mission and Jane's. You'll partner with the teams driving Jane's broader AI strategy, building on what they're creating and helping influence where it goes next, because it's not something any one group can do alone.

  • Partner with the design and engineering leads on your team to define the customer problems you're solving and the expected outcomes. Together, you'll build a roadmap around them and make the calls on what to prioritize, what to try first and what to say no to, bringing others along with you as you go.

  • Consistently solve problems that matter to our users, working backwards from each one to a right-sized solution that makes a difference for our customers and for Jane. You'll know our customers and the competitive landscape so well that you become the go-to expert in your space

What Experience We Need

  • 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS company, including taking a product from 0-to-1. You've spotted an opportunity, won buy-in for it and shaped the plan to bring it to market, from deciding how to validate early ideas through to wider testing like betas, and built the confidence needed to commercialize it.

  • Experience leading planning and strategy work, from shaping a longer-term vision for your space to breaking it into clear priorities. You're a confident facilitator who is comfortable running workshops to explore problems, shape ideas and reach decisions.

  • A track record of shipping products that made a clear difference for customers, rather than a company-wide revenue number you contributed a slice of. You're comfortable defining what success looks like and using data to guide your decisions along the way.

  • Experience shipping AI-powered products and features that solve customer problems, and across the wider company, where you've helped influence a broader AI strategy by building alongside other teams rather than going it alone.

  • You've worked with a broad group of partners and built alignment in a fast-moving environment without slowing things down. You're skilled at communicating complex problems and solutions clearly and bringing senior leaders and other stakeholders into your thinking, which is core to how Jane works. For example, every week, there's a forum where anyone can share their work and get feedback from company leadership

  • If you've worked in communications, healthcare, AI or adjacent spaces like marketing automation, built SMB or B2C products, or navigated a regulated environment, that's a plus, but not required to apply.

"If you don't meet every single qualification but are excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you."

More About Jane

Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.

We build the products and tools that thousands of clinics rely on every day to run their businesses, care for their patients, and grow their communities. That level of impact means every person at Jane plays an important role in how we show up for our customers. We're all responsible for being deeply connected to their needs, obsessed with improving their experience, and proud of the difference our work makes in their day-to-day lives.

Jane is growing fast, and that growth brings exciting challenges that call for adaptability, resilience, learning agility, and humility. We're proud of what we've built and quick to admit what we don't know yet. We listen, learn, and adjust as we go. More than 70,000 businesses run on Jane which has 250,000+ practitioners interacting with our product on a daily basis and growth is continuing to accelerate.

Our goal isn't just delivery - it's delight. We move quickly, communicate openly, and solve real problems together. If you're energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and eager to learn with others, you'll thrive at Jane.

Compensation & Benefits

At Jane, we're committed to paying fairly, clearly, and above all, paying for growth. This role has an annual salary range of CAD $117,100 to CAD $182,900. While that is a large range, it is intentional. It reflects the full growth journey someone might take in the role, from developing skills early on to becoming highly proficient and ultimately achieving excellence.

Most new hires join at the accomplished stage, which for this role represents an annual salary of CAD $139,000. A starting salary below this typically indicates a candidate with strong potential who is still developing key skills. Salaries above this usually apply to existing team members who have made a significant impact and bring deep Jane-specific knowledge.

We believe in paying for growth. You’ll have regular career development conversations with your manager and your compensation will grow as you gain experience and contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Paying clearly is one of our compensation fundamentals. Watch this short video to learn how our salary bands are set. You’re also encouraged to ask questions about compensation at any point during the interview process.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, You can learn more about it here!


Jane takes job scams and candidate fraud seriously. Jane will only contact you from an @jane.app email address. We'll never contact you from a personal email, ask for payment, or request purchases during the hiring process. If something doesn't seem right, please reach out to us at hiring@jane.app before sharing any personal information.
